headline: Long-read data support sample-specific methylation calls and assembly-based variant inference
label: Long Read Variant And Methylation
summary: New long-read methods span CpG likelihood modeling, local-assembly SV calling and signal-level assembly, extending resolution of sample-specific epigenetic and structural variation.
synthesis: The most coherent thread is extracting sample-specific genomic and epigenomic information directly from long reads. The published bsseq framework applies a read-based likelihood model to Nanopore and PacBio data to identify sample-specific CpG loci. Adjacent preprints address the structural side: a benchmark of five local-assembly consensus strategies for SV calling on HiFi and ONT data reports data-type-dependent behavior, and HARICOT assembles raw nanopore signals without basecalling using fuzzy de Bruijn graphs. DiGi poses diploid genotyping on a pangenome as an exact integer program. The remaining items, covering circular RNA assembly, viral linkage disequilibrium and low-input CNV detection, are short-read or low-input methods and relate only loosely. What is new is the pairing of per-read statistical modeling with assembly-level variant resolution; the items do not show a single joint methylation-genotype analysis.
